thread:
ella: Proposal: add a "simulate+verify" action to Console so teams can safely validate config flips (routing/quotas) before rollout.
noah: yes. must provide both a sampled mirror mode and a modeled-cost fallback for consented tenants.
samir: constraints: don't impact live traffic, scrub PII, allow region/tenant excludes, show confidence interval.
ella: Console UX: modal with two modes, sample pct slider, time window, and a small summary card after run with p50/p95 deltas, error delta, and cost delta + verdict.
ops-bot: runbook: if runner reports backend_saturation > 0.6 -> auto-pause, mark verdict INCONCLUSIVE, notify #eng-oncall.
noah: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/config/simulate_verify
{
  "config_id": "quota_routing_v1",
  "mode": "mirror", // or "modeled"
  "sample_pct": 2,
  "window_mins": 30,
  "exclude_regions": ["eu-west-1"]
}
```
samir: Telemetry: emit 'simulate_summary' with tags: config_id, mode, sample_pct, p50_delta_ms, p95_delta_ms, error_delta_ppm, cost_usd, conf_low, conf_high, sample_count. Send to 'config-sim' topic.
trina: Safety predicate idea: default pass if p95_delta_ms < 15 && error_delta_ppm < 250 && cost_delta_pct < 7. Make predicate pluggable for route owners.
ella: Privacy: scrub user ids and request bodies; if consent absent, force modeled mode and log fallback reason.
noah: Ownership: I'll build runner + saturation probes. Samir can wire telemetry and dashboard tile.
samir: will add pass/fail badge + recent history. include link to raw summary and audit id.
ella: I'll do Console button + audit logging (initiator, diff snapshot, preflight_id).
ops-bot: reminder: log all simulate requests to audit trail with initiator & timestamp.
trina: I'll loop in legal for consent language.
ella: cool. I'll open an RFC and a draft API PR tomorrow behind a runtime flag.
